title: Pane queue keeps an entry whose card file briefly fails to parse
notes: Left open by #408's review. pane-pool.ts:123 drops a queued entry as 'not on the board' when its card file fails to parse for a moment (for example mid-write during a board sync), so a queued ship silently vanishes. Fix only in the drain's readiness read: an unreadable card holds the entry, it does not drop it; queueRefusal and withdrawnColumn keep their board. The final check reverted a broader attempt (4485d81e) for nulling the board there too.
